description: This file contains boxing logic for converting concrete arguments into a vector of IValue objects, including utility templates, boxing predicates, and kernel wrapper implementations for various function signatures within the PyTorch ATen library.

classes.name: is_mutable_tensor_ref
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is a mutable tensor reference.

classes.name: is_tuple_of_mutable_tensor_refs
classes.description: Type trait to check if a tuple consists solely of mutable tensor references.

classes.name: has_ivalue_to
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type has an IValue::to<T>() method.

classes.name: ivalue_to_helper
classes.description: Helper to determine the type returned by IValue::to<T>().

classes.name: PopResult
classes.description: Helper class to pop and convert return values from the stack, supporting single values and tuples.

classes.name: BoxedKernelWrapper
classes.description: Template class that wraps a kernel function, handling argument boxing, kernel invocation, and result unboxing for various function signatures.

methods.name: boxArgs
methods.description: Utility to box multiple arguments into a stack of IValues.

methods.name: boxed_size
methods.description: Calculate the total boxed size of a list of argument types.

methods.name: boxToStack
methods.description: Box a single argument into the IValue stack.

methods.name: boxArgsToStack
methods.description: Recursively box multiple arguments into the IValue stack.
